mainEntity.name: Is Generative Engine Optimization expensive for a small roofing business?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of Generative Engine Optimization for a small roofing business can vary depending on the scope of services and the provider. While there is an investment involved, GEO can be more cost-effective than traditional content creation methods due to the efficiency of AI. It allows for the rapid production of high-quality, targeted content that would otherwise require extensive manual labor. Many providers offer tiered packages that can be scaled to fit different budget sizes. The long-term ROI often outweighs the initial expenditure by driving more qualified leads and increasing conversion rates, making it a valuable investment for sustained growth.
